messages:
Evelyn (prod): Sync request: customers asking for clear streaming behavior for chat+functions: transport parity (SSE/WS), compact deltas, explicit finish reasons, and a modest resume story. Can we draft an MVP checklist?

Marco (eng): Key decision points: transport compatibility (SSE easier for browsers, WS for multiplexing), delta grain (token vs chunk vs json-patch), and resume semantics (opaque token vs byte offsets). Tradeoffs noted.

Tara (runtime): Pragmatic runtime plan: emit chunk deltas (~32 tokens) by default, token mode behind flag. Issue an HMAC-signed resume_token every M chunks (M=8) embedding seq+expiry so we avoid DB state for short TTL resumes.

Ibrahim (devex): SDK needs: a single parser for envelope {event, seq, data, meta}, a stream_end event with finish_reason enum {completed,truncated,cancelled,func_error,system_error}, and helpers for reconnect+resume using opaque token.

Nell (design): UX rules: recommend clients render partial tokens immediately, but advise "safe-apply" for structured function outputs until stream_end. Provide examples for truncated vs cancelled displays.

Evelyn (prod): Proposed MVP launch gates: 1) spec doc with envelope+examples, 2) browser SSE and node WS SDKs that parse same envelope, 3) resume_token HMAC design and TTL, 4) telemetry: tokens_generated, tokens_emitted, resumes, finish_reason counts, 5) privacy note for streamed function outputs.

Marco (eng): Backpressure: server stalls up to a bounded queue Q, then emits throttle event with Retry-After and sets finish_reason=truncated only if we must abort. Document observable signals so SDKs surface them.

Tara (runtime): Telemetry/ops: add stream-sla dashboard (avg chunk latency, resume_success_rate, finish_reason_error_rate) and alert on error >1% in 5m. Also GC for resume tokens after expiry.

Ibrahim (devex): Rollout: private beta with 2 customers for 4 weeks, collect resume metrics and proxy compatibility issues, then GA behind opt-in flag. SDKs to include reconnect examples and backoff.

ops-bot: ops-bot: nightly canary for streaming/mvp branch scheduled 02:30 UTC.

Evelyn (prod): Owners: Marco -> transport+envelope; Tara -> resume+telemetry; Ibrahim -> SDK examples/docs; Nell -> UX examples. Please add top-2 open risks by EOD.
